Abstract

Motivation
The design and evaluation of metagenomic sequencing pipelines depends on realistic synthetic data. Existing simulators often emphasize either short-read error models or limited community structure, leaving gaps for benchmarking hybrid analysis workflows.

Results
We present MetagenomeScope, a Python-based framework for generating configurable microbial community datasets with sequence-aware read profiles, user-defined abundance shifts, and reproducible parallel execution. The package emphasizes ease of use, documentation, and flexible defaults for experimental planning and method assessment.

Availability and implementation
Source code and documentation are available under an open-source license.

Supplementary information
Supplementary data are available online.
result.title: MetagenomeScope: a sequence-aware framework for benchmarking long-read microbial community simulators
